title.zh: DSH 插件索引 · 观察池

description.en: Passed every hard gate but scored low or carries unresolved soft warnings.
description.zh: 通过全部硬门，但分数偏低或带有未解决的软风险。

description.en: DSH plugin: per-model proxy routing (http/https/socks5) with a settings UI — e.g. opencode/muse-spark-1.2-contributor needs a proxy while sibling models stay direct
Google Antigravity (agy CLI) models for DeepSeek Harness — stream Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS subscriptions into DSH with thinking, tool activity, token usage and in-GUI Google OAuth login.
Automatic provider/model fallback chains for DeepSeek Harness agents when LLM requests keep failing (retry exhausted, auth, quota, rate limit)
Free web search & fetch plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) with multi-engine fallback (Tavily, Exa, Brave, Baidu, SearXNG and more)
Create Blender product scenes in DSH with editable recipes, model imports, previews and PNG/MP4 delivery; includes workbench and agent configuration.

DeepSeek Harness companion for ClineBot / ClinePass: dynamic subscription models sync, quota exhaustion warnings, session metrics, dedicated settings page, live usage limits, and /cline slash-command.
Skill management plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): list / enable / disable / delete / add skills from the web UI settings panel. 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供技能管理：列表 / 启用 / 停用 / 删除 / 添加。
DSH Archive Manager - preview, restore, and delete archived sessions from the settings page
DeepSeek Harness Agent preset manager: register and manage agent presets at runtime without editing any DSH configuration file.
DSH 原生多平台调研流水线插件：harvest_scout(多平台发现)/harvest_deep_research(深度研报)/harvest_extract(穿透抓取)/harvest_verify(交叉验证)/harvest_audit(可信度审计)。源于自研 omni-scope 方法论，自包含。
Feishu and Lark text, image, and file channel bridge for DeepSeek Harness
QQ Bot channel bridge for DeepSeek Harness
WeCom AI Bot text, image, and file channel bridge for DeepSeek Harness
Official Weixin iLink text, image, and file bridge for DeepSeek Harness
Arrow-key navigation for the DSH Web GUI: Up/Down switch sessions inside the current workspace, Left/Right switch workspaces.

DSH plugin: one shell tool that runs commands through PowerShell, Git Bash, MSYS2, or WSL on Windows, plus an embedded terminal for the bottom dock (dsh-better-sidebar's terminal tab) with per-shell activation switches and a default-shell fallback chain.
DeepSeek Harness homepage-style background skin: WebGL fluid, dot grid and digital whale. Dark and light variants included.
The front page for a session you left running: what happened, what broke, and what is waiting on you — computed from the durable event log, never generated by a model.
dsh-paste-dock — DeepSeek Harness 插件:大段文本粘贴自动存为 pastes/*.txt,输入框上方 dock 卡片管理,草稿内只留最小徽标。

Patch-style file editing for DeepSeek Harness: one apply_patch tool accepting git/unified diff (default) and Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), with all-or-nothing application, read-before-write intent dance, sandbox-aware delete/move,  (declarative volatile settings).

DSH permission-gate for the DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5 line: a single self-sufficient, deterministic-first, fail-closed gate covering P0 hard-deny -> P1 session grant -> P2 static rule (allow/deny) chain -> P3 optional LLM semantic classifier -> P4 ask, with command whitelist/blacklist.

Cut token cost without cutting model intelligence — a DeepSeek Harness (dsh) bundle plugin: structure-aware compression + TOON-style lossless encoding first + reversible spill-to-disk + real-time dashboard.

Preset doctor for DeepSeek Harness: auto-detects broken agent presets (legacy format, renamed packages, stale config keys) and mechanically repairs them to the current 0.1.7+ syntax, with backup, atomic writes and idempotence.
L0~L3 分层蒸馏记忆插件 for DeepSeek Harness：自动捕获对话（L0）、抽取原子记忆（L1）、整合场景块（L2）、蒸馏核心画像/团队方法论（L3），并在模型步骤前自动召回注入。移植自 MemoryCore (TencentDB Agent Memory) 的管线设计。
Provider request metadata minimization extension for DeepSeek Harness
高峰自动会话门：周末模式 + 高峰自动暂停 + 官方源二维判定 + 会话级冻结 + 后端自动重试。
DSH Web 插件：会话管家（合并包）—— 会话历史文件（归档浏览与清理）与健康检查（体检 → 处方 → 出院），外加独立 FTS5 会话内容搜索索引（标题/内容双模式、增量同步、非破坏性整理与快照导入导出）。不碰会话日志、只做可逆处置。
Shut down Windows after DeepSeek Harness tasks complete — draggable button, auto-dodge, cancellable countdown. 任务完成后自动关机（按钮可拖动、自动避让，倒计时可取消）。
One plugin for a calmer DeepSeek Harness: reading view + message rail + smart history loading, for Harness 0.1.0-0.2.1 (all rc).

DSH updater + official docs sync plugin for DeepSeek Harness: one-click npm update of @deepseek-ai/dsh with real-time progress, an idle-based timeout so slow networks are not killed, a staged swap that keeps a rollback point (cleanable from the card), incremental sync of the official docs/ to local…
GLM (Zhipu bigmodel) web search provider for DeepSeek Harness: native web_search via the Anthropic-compatible Messages API, with GLM response-format translation.
连接小沐（MuChe 数字生命）的 dsh 插件：可以和有持续状态的小沐聊天，小沐可调用本机 dsh 执行任务
Aident CLI — umbrella access to Loadout integrations, Playbook automation, Intern tools, and the Aident platform.
政务办事指南巡检插件 — 检测漏项/语义/逻辑/格式错误，输出合规审计报告，516测试全通过，v3.8.1新城市白名单补全+网办深度枚举配置化+表格下载实质内容豁免

Model Router for official DeepSeek Harness Desktop: cost-aware task routing, dependent work packages and official vendor CLI discovery, installation and execution. GAL is available separately as @ljwei-stak/dsh-galgame.
TraceScope DeepSeek Harness plugin: impact analysis + design diff sidebar UI
DSH Market 插件端：cordis 侧边栏插件（浏览/搜索/猜你喜欢/一键安装/已装管理），核心逻辑来自 @dsh-market/core
Microi吾码 AI 开发 CLI 与多宿主 Plugin：服务器连接、Skills、MCP、V8 同步和低代码交付
AgentOne 平台集成：平台模型、SkillHub 技能、套餐、CLI、飞书云盘共享文件夹（web/官方桌面端侧栏页签 + 左栏底部入口；「启用云盘」后 AI 可读取/搜索资料、看最近更新、存文档、传本地文件）、左栏「工作台」面板（卡片集中打开内嵌应用：DOC数字化AI运营平台，网页内嵌或 applink 唤起飞书客户端，切面板不断页）

Learning assistant extension for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): DeepTutor tutoring for your agent — deep explanations, self-test questions, learning paths, personal knowledge-base search (RAG), and note archiving (HTTP/WS first, CLI fallback; auto-adapts local/remote deployment).
DSH Desktop 界面增强：页内查找（Cmd+F）、轮次编号、上下文压缩行常显、建议、每步耗时、折叠文件夹状态计数、会话信息（含上下文注入 C1 视图）、工具管理、Skill 管理、独立远程接入与手机体验。
DSH 远程目录（手机端）：在选文件夹流程里多出「电脑」页签，进入电脑目录、在电脑上发起对话，并把电脑的实时消息流同步到手机本地界面（只传文本，不映射桌面）。
尽可能的使dsh适配竖屏等移动端设备
DeepSeek Harness bridge plugin: exposes the newest Zhipu/Z.AI coding-plan models (e.g. glm-5.3) on the zai-coding-cn route before the bundled pi-ai catalog catches up.
Query the dshbase plugin directory from inside DeepSeek Harness — search, list, and get install commands for 1700+ plugins.

dsh-browser-cdp: DSH browser plugin — attach to a running Chrome/Edge over CDP (no bundled browser needed); structured browser-automation tools (30+ bcdp_*) that drive the vendored ego runtime through ctx.subprocess, plus a realtime watch panel (live SSE screencast + direct mouse interaction + down…

dsh-mcp-registry: DSH plugin — a governed registry for MCP connectors (stdio / streamable-http). Multi-level fail-closed authorization (global switch → per-connector permission mode → per-tool grants → live server-annotation evidence), mcpServers JSON import that rejects malformed args loudly inste…
DSH web 侧边栏搜索索引：标题搜索 ↔ 内容搜索一键切换，内容搜索按会话聚合展示标题与命中片段；自带独立索引（不依赖 DSH 官方全文索引），支持增量同步、非破坏性整理与快照导入导出。

DSH web 插件：通过 DSH v0.1.5-rc.1 原生第三方语言 API（locale.addLanguage + register(ns, locale, dict)）注册 19 种内置语言字典（ja/ko/fr/...），语言直接出现在 DSH 设置页原生 Language 行中切换，未覆盖文案按 fallback 链回退英文。 | DSH web plugin: registers 19 bundled third-language dictionaries (ja/ko/fr/...) through DSH v0.1.5-rc.1's native language-pa…
DeepSeek Harness bundle plugin that connects ZenTao PMS (禅道) REST API v1 as model tools: products, projects, stories, tasks, bugs and more.
DSH Web GUI 底部终端面板插件——node-pty 驱动的多标签交互式终端（Windows ConPTY / POSIX openpty）
